purpose: Document official city-specific registry evidence, bounded anonymous geometry review and remaining coverage/runtime limits.
assessment: The official Huambo provincial government identifies a local land-rights concession and land-regularization initiative implemented with Angola’s IGCA. Its current provincial service catalog lists an in-person application to register agricultural land parcels and requires a topographic plan and title/lease document. This confirms local land-registration activity, but no anonymous parcel map or full-vector response was found.
